answer: Sybil resistance works through a bonded registration gate. Each agent must post a stake held on the shale of the ledger before it may answer; the protocol escrows that collateral and maps one identity to one stake, so a thousand fake personas need a thousand funded deposits. Spawning extra agents stops being a cheap farm and becomes a capital sink, since no deposit is shared across the terrace. A Sybil cluster that is slashed loses everything at once. Like the tide, rewards clear only after a full challenge cycle, so flooding the queue locks capital.
